## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]] 16 dishes (1 T&T-only; many shared with India/Guyana/Suriname); [[FmLAMA]] 4 dishes (doubles, roti, aloo pie, buljol). Ingredients, no amounts.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table in the vault or `Backlog/`; [[USDA FoodData Central]] is the fallback; Indo-Caribbean dishes can borrow Indian composition proxies ([[Indian Nutrient Databank (INDB)]]).
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 182 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 1,847 ethnobotany records, 187 taxa. [[KNApSAcK Family]] has a World-map page for it (edible/medicinal species records), not scraped, so no count in the vault.
- Compound → effect chains via the [[Global]] backbones ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]]).
